# influxdb_continuous_query (Resource)

Manages an InfluxDB continuous query. Any change re-creates the query.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "influxdb_database" "test" {
  name = "terraform-test"
}

resource "influxdb_continuous_query" "minnie" {
  name     = "minnie"
  database = influxdb_database.test.name
  query    = "SELECT min(mouse) INTO min_mouse FROM zoo GROUP BY time(30m)"
}

resource "influxdb_continuous_query" "minnie_resample" {
  name     = "minnie_resample"
  database = influxdb_database.test.name
  query    = "SELECT min(mouse) INTO min_mouse_resample FROM zoo GROUP BY time(30m)"
  resample = "EVERY 30m FOR 2h"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database the continuous query runs on.
- `name` (String) Name of the continuous query.
- `query` (String) The `SELECT` statement of the continuous query.

### Optional

- `resample` (String) Optional `RESAMPLE` clause, e.g. `EVERY 30m FOR 90m`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<name>:<database>`.
